datasets.name: NOAA ETOPO 2022 60 arc-second surface elevation -> ocean mask, height, normal
datasets.organization: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information
datasets.purpose: Earth specular (ocean) mask, height/bump and normal map
datasets.mechanism: OPeNDAP .dods (z[lat][lon], stride 2 = 10800x5400) -> area resample -> derived maps
datasets.citation: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information. 2022: ETOPO 2022 15 Arc-Second Global Relief Model. doi:10.25921/fd45-gt74
datasets.cachePolicy: versioned offline snapshot; optional online refresh
datasets.fallback: Use a flat albedo colour per body (see index.json) and keep the scene running; never fetch online during the exhibition
datasets.limitations: Stride-2 subsample of the 60" grid (~3.7 km); normal slope exaggerated x6; ocean mask = z<0 (includes Caspian/Dead Sea depressions); bathymetry not used for normals.

datasets.name: USGS Astrogeology planetary WMS global mosaics
datasets.organization: USGS Astrogeology Science Center (NASA mission data)
datasets.purpose: Global surface maps: Moon, Mars, Mercury, Venus surface, Io, Europa, Ganymede, Callisto, Titan, Enceladus, Triton, Pluto, Charon
datasets.query: see per-body endpoint in index.json credits / records
datasets.citation: USGS Astrogeology Science Center / NASA mission teams (see credits in index.json)
datasets.rateLimits: not documented (requests throttled to >=1 s per host)
datasets.cachePolicy: versioned offline snapshot; optional online refresh
datasets.fallback: Use a flat albedo colour per body (see index.json) and keep the scene running; never fetch online during the exhibition
datasets.limitations: Server-resampled; Pluto/Charon/Triton far sides unobserved and Europa/Ganymede/Callisto polar gaps are filled with smooth interpolation (illustrative); Moon/Mercury/Pluto/Charon/Enceladus are greyscale; Venus colour is artificial; Moon has no bump map in this build. Moon/Mars normal maps are derived from 8-bit grey elevation stretches (approximate heights). Triton/Pluto/Charon unobserved regions are faded to mean colour; coverage masks provided.
